title: Content Output
description: Schema for content outputs produced by the Content Agent. Covers captions, hooks, scripts, and CTAs for any platform.

content_id.description: Unique ID for this content item. Format: CC-[BRAND]-[YYYYMMDD]-[NNN]

brand_id.description: Brand identifier. Default: VQ for Vị Cuốn.

content_type.description: Type of content this output represents.

target_audience.description: Target audience segment. Must match a segment in Brand Brain.

hook.description: Opening hook line for caption or video. Must be attention-grabbing within first 1-2 seconds.
hook.example: Bữa trưa hôm nay chưa biết ăn gì?

caption.description: Full post caption including hook, body, and CTA.

script.description: Video script with scene breakdown and voiceover. Null if content type is not video.

cta.example: Đặt ngay hoặc ghé Vị Cuốn hôm nay!

visual_direction.description: Brief visual direction for this content. E.g., color palette suggestion, shot type, mood.

offer.description: Any offer or promotion included. Must be Owner-provided. Use [OWNER_TO_PROVIDE_OFFER] if pending.

approval_status.description: Current approval state. Published requires prior Approved state.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this output was created.

notes.description: Optional notes for the Owner or Reviewer.
